Anonymus4377 You should have no problem taking dual citizenship as a German now, but you can also take the permanent residency, which gives you almost the same rights (except a passport, the right to vote in national elections, and the ability to leave the country for more than 7 years without your status expiring).
I am German and I took the residency option back in the days because they had not changed the German law yet at that point.
